rules: Before building a policy that chooses, measure whether valuable choice headroom exists.
A capability enters mandatory architecture only if an explicit claim requires it and the claim meets the evidence policy.
A supported capability claim does not imply custom implementation; reuse is tested separately.
Claims may be historically supported while operationally stale.

claims.statement: Task and executor heterogeneity creates economically meaningful headroom between the best fixed execution configuration and the retrospective per-task oracle configuration.
claims.primary_falsifier: Retrospective oracle is not materially better than the best fixed configuration after complete-system accounting.
claims.architecture_if_supported: routing opportunity exists; policy still unproven

claims.statement: Minimum plausible execution followed by verification and selective escalation can improve the verified-success/cost frontier relative to strong-direct and simpler fixed baselines.
claims.primary_falsifier: Cheap-direct plus verification or strong-direct matches or dominates escalation after failed-attempt, verification, and handoff overhead.

claims.statement: Transferable task continuity beyond workspace state reduces recovery cost or increases verified completion enough to pay for its transfer and maintenance overhead.
claims.primary_falsifier: Workspace-only resumption or an existing generic compressor matches structured task continuity on the Pareto frontier.
claims.architecture_if_supported: continuity capability justified; implementation source still open

claims.statement: Different tasks or task states benefit from materially different execution compositions, creating meaningful headroom between the best fixed composition and a retrospective composition oracle.
claims.primary_falsifier: Best fixed composition approximately matches the composition oracle after coordination overhead.
claims.architecture_if_supported: composition-selection opportunity exists; policy still unproven

claims.statement: State-aware sequential decisions during execution outperform the best fixed cascade and simple deterministic rules after controller and handoff overhead.
claims.primary_falsifier: Best fixed cascade or simple rules reaches an equivalent or superior verified-success/cost frontier.
claims.architecture_if_refuted: static rules/cascade; no learned or LLM controller

claims.statement: Combining only previously justified routing, continuity, composition, verification, and control capabilities preserves a material Pareto improvement after all interaction overhead.
claims.primary_falsifier: Strong-direct, simple cascade, or a thinner system reaches an equivalent or superior external holdout frontier.
claims.architecture_if_supported: integrated DV candidate, limited to components that survived ablation

claims.statement: For any supported capability, no existing provider, standard, framework, or thin adapter provides an equivalent effect at lower total integration and maintenance cost.
claims.primary_falsifier: Existing provider or composition is equivalent or better under the required contract and accounting.
claims.architecture_if_supported: custom implementation may be justified at minimum sufficient scope

claims.statement: The retained DV capabilities continue to provide value or can be recalibrated without core redesign when model capability, price, harness, availability, or task distribution changes materially.
claims.primary_falsifier: Material ecosystem change makes the retained architecture noncompetitive or requires broad core reconstruction.
claims.architecture_if_refuted: retest, simplify, replace provider, or retire affected capability

negative_guardrails: Full trajectories are not assumed beneficial in escalation.
Multi-agent is not assumed superior to single-agent.
More context is not assumed superior.
The strongest model is not assumed economically optimal.
A learned or LLM controller is not assumed superior to deterministic rules.
Existing DV or MetaO code is not assumed preferable to external reuse.
A component that once helped is not assumed permanently useful.
